messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected on /v1/stream (us-west-2). p99 jumped from ~2.8s to ~6.2s over the last 5m. SLO breach triggered. Paging #incidents oncall.

mary: Acknowledged — I'm on it. Starting quick blast radius checks.

alex: Oncall here. Any customer impact yet?

mary: Early signal: ~4% of streaming sessions showing elevated RTTs and some client retries. No significant 5xx increase. Dashboard: https://grafana.company.com/d/streaming/latency?panelId=3

jun: Quick readout: p95=1.9s, p99=6.1s. Notable: KV cache hit rate dropped from ~98% -> ~62% starting ~10m ago. Panels 'kv-cache-hits' and 'kvcache_evictions' show a spike.

taylor: I rolled a small runtime config canary to pool-a ~12m ago (runtime.kv.reclaim=aggressive) to test memory pressure handling. Reverting now — started rollback.

alex: If eviction storm that's consistent with tail latency. Mitigations (prioritized): 1) rollback reclaim change, 2) temporarily increase cache quota on pool-a, 3) route a portion of traffic to pool-b fallback.

mary: Rollback command issued: `/deploy rollback runtime-config pool-a` — tracking.

incident-bot: Action recorded: rollback started by taylor at 3952468060. Estimated duration ~30s.

jun: Ops check: prometheus query I ran: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total[1m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_requests_total[1m]))` -> hitrate now ~62%. Also `increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[10m])` shows eviction surge aligned with the rollout.

taylor: Enabled prefix-cache read-only mode on pool-a to reduce backend lookups: `/infra run enable-prefix-cache --pool pool-a`

taylor: Also scaling pool-a +2 nodes as a protective measure: `/infra scale pool-a 2`

alex: I'll enable a 10% route to pool-b fallback once rollback completes to shave tail latency for in-flight sessions.

product-ops: Customer ops note: 11 customers flagged with prolonged streams, 3 are EU-based — AMs notified and we emailed those on the affected tenants. No escalations yet.

mary: Rollback completed at ~3952468085. Observability: kv hitrate climbing back toward 94% within ~60s of rollback.

jun: Current metrics now: p95=1.8s, p99=2.4s. Evictions decreased to baseline. Streaming stalls/trailing stalls reduced.

alex: Good. Next steps: 1) post-incident postmortem to capture why reclaim change was pushed in a canary without kv-hit checks, 2) add rollout gating (automatic rollback if kv-hit drops >5% in 15m), 3) add an alert for sudden eviction bursts.

taylor: I'll open a ticket/PR: add rollout guard + automated kv-hit pre/post check in our deployment pipeline and a small playbook snippet for oncall.

mary: Oncall handoff scheduled in 30m to alex. Incident doc: https://confluence.company.com/display/INC/3952468-notes — leaving timeline and metrics.

incident-bot: Incident status: SLOs restored and p99 returned below threshold. Closing incident thread. Follow-up ticket created and assigned to taylor. Severity: S2.
